body.name: Fithandle
body.def: On \(\mathcal M^{\beta}_{K,\varepsilon}(B_{\mathrm H})\), fit one raw label-aligned tensor-product B-spline product likelihood, derive \(\widehat m\) from \(\widehat f\), threshold and renormalize \(\widehat M_A,\widehat M_Z\) into \(\bar M_A,\bar M_Z\), derive every bridge and operator from the cleaned law, and use \(\tau_G=\varepsilon/2\); the likelihood-curvature, localization, boundary, and uniform-rate proof remains the explicit open part
body.role: Non-oracle support-cleaned starting move for coherent nuisance construction.
